gist create.--web: Opens a browser after creation. The harness deliberately sets GH_BROWSER/BROWSER=false and has no browser-observation fixture; creation itself is covered through normal and stdin invocations.

gist view.--web: Browser-only view is not observable in this headless harness (GH_BROWSER/BROWSER=false); REST-backed rendered, raw, filename and file-list views are exercised instead.

release view.--web: Launches an external browser, intentionally disabled by GH_BROWSER/BROWSER=false in the harness. Terminal, JSON, jq, template and latest-release views are exercised.
